description: Works out a dish's calories from its recipe, as the free menu calorie counter on restaurantdoctorai.com does: each ingredient's calories from USDA FoodData Central (a list of 118 common foods) or its pack label, added up, shared by the plates it makes or by portion weight, and rounded once the way US, Ontario or UK and EU menus show calories. Ingredients are matched to that list, never guessed: words that fit several foods come back with the foods to pick from, and words that fit none with the nearest foods, or as not on the list. A pack label's kcal per 100 g comes from the owner's own label, never an estimate: without one, that ingredient can't be counted yet. Returns the menu figure, the exact one, how it was worked out with each food's FDC ID, what to check before printing, and a link that opens the counter with the same recipe filled in. It's an estimate, not a lab test. The figures aren't stored; only an anonymous daily count of calculator runs is kept.

cookedWeight.description: With weight: the whole batch, weighed after cooking. Required then.

country.description: Where the menu is: sets the energy figure and its rounding. us = US; ontario = Canada (Ontario); ukeu = UK, Ireland or EU (kcal, with the EU's energy factors).

dish.description: Optional: the dish's name, for the record.

ingredients.description: What goes into the dish or batch, one entry each. Required.

amount.description: How much goes in, after trimming, in unit. Weighed if possible. Required.

food.description: The food: its name on the counter's list of USDA foods, as an earlier answer gave it, or the owner's words for it, matched to that list. Words that fit several foods, or none, come back as a tool error naming the foods to pick from, or saying it isn't on the list. With kcalPer100g, just its name.

kcalPer100g.description: For a food not on the list: kcal per 100 g from the nutrition panel on the owner's own pack, as the owner reads it (a US label gives a serving: its calories ÷ its grams × 100). Never an estimate by the assistant: if the owner has no label, the ingredient can't be counted yet. Weighed only.

unit.description: g, kg, oz or lb for any food. ml, l, floz, cup, tbsp or tsp (US measures) for liquids and fats only; each for foods counted by the piece.

plates.description: With plates: how many plates it makes, 1 for a single plate. Required then.

portionWeight.description: With weight: one portion. Required then.

portioning.description: plates: one plate, or a batch shared into plates (12 pancakes). weight: portions weighed from a cooked batch (a ladle of soup).

name: restaurantdoctor_menu_calories

beforePrint.description: The page's notes on posting calories in this country.

checks.description: Foods matched from the owner's words, every pack label figure sent (not USDA's) with its value, and the page's hints on weighing each food.

anyOf.description: The dish's name, when one was sent.

energy.description: What menus there call the figure.

guide.description: Who has to post calories, and what such a menu shows.

source.description: USDA's description and FDC ID, or the pack label.

link.description: Opens the counter on the website with this recipe filled in.

anyOf.description: By the plate: the plates it makes.

result.description: The result in the page's words, in its order.

rounded.description: The figure for the menu, a plate or a portion, rounded once by the country's rule.

workedOut.description: How it was worked out, with each food's FDC ID.
